messages:
jasmin: quick heads up — prototype 'Admin heatmap' landed in staging under /console/metrics. It's a role-scoped view that overlays per-route quotas and P95s by tenant. Going to canary A tomorrow.
oliver: :eyes: link?
jasmin: https://redwood-internal/console/heatmap (staging). main concern: telemetry labels include tenant_id and role_label; that could surface usage patterns when combined with route names.
sanjay: do you mean leakage of tenant access patterns? where exactly?
jasmin: if an admin with read-only perms can open heatmap and see per-tenant p95s for specific model routes we could unintentionally reveal which tenants are heavy on particular routes.
priya: suggestion: default to obfuscated tenant ids in the UI unless caller has console:unmask_tenants privilege. Add a toggle 'show tenant hints' gated by permission.
jasmin: yep. also thinking we should sample full-identity telemetry and store masked aggregates for the UI. backend will return masked_tenant: "t-****" vs real tenant when permission missing.
oliver: backend enforcement is key — don't rely on UI checks. metrics service must check principal scopes and redact before emitting.
sanjay: agree. add server-side param ?unmask=true but return 403 if principal lacks console:unmask_tenants.
jasmin: pseudopolicy in prod-config:
```
roles:
  - name: console_admin
    permissions:
      - console:view_metrics
      - console:unmask_tenants
  - name: ops_readonly
    permissions:
      - console:view_metrics
```
priya: rollout plan?
jasmin: canary 5% orgs tomorrow, sample_rate=0.05 for identity telemetry, preview flag enabled. If no issues, 50% next week. We'll emit audit events for any unmask action.
oliver: audit event should include actor, target_tenant (hashed), route, unmask=true/false.
jasmin: agreed. event name: console.metrics.view -> {actor, target_tenant_hash, route, unmask}
priya: also need quota protections — some admins might run heavy queries. set soft rate-limit 1 qps and hard 10 qpm per admin via rate-limiter middleware.
sanjay: add unit/integration tests to assert metric redaction and 403 on unprivileged unmask.
deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: staging -> 2024-11-04T09:00 UTC (5% orgs)
ops-bot: FYI created ticket INF-1289 to track telemetry privacy tasks
oliver: :thumbsup: 
priya: I'll mock UX copy for the toggle and add microcopy explaining 'obfuscated for privacy' + link to audit logs
jasmin: thanks team — I'll update the RFC and ping security for quick review.
